$description: Vevo public marketing site (hq.vevo.com), signed out, measured 2026-11-19. Light only. Wix Studio custom properties on :root plus computed styles at 1440 CSS px.

display.$description: Wix-hosted display face used for headlines, nav, buttons and body. Proprietary; not committed. Fallback is Arial.

$extensions.source: Measured. computed font-family on h1.font_0 and nav label p.wGxoBM, https://www.hq.vevo.com/ 1440, 2026-11-19. @font-face src is a wixstatic ufonts woff2.
Measured. --cookie-banner-font-family and Accept button computed font-family.

display.$description: Declared --font_0. At 1440 CSS px the hero computes to 166.3px / 157.985px with letter-spacing -1.663px. At 390 CSS px it computes to 56.3953px.

$extensions.source: Measured. --font_0 on :root. Computed size recorded in $extensions.computed1440.

heading.$description: Declared --wst-font-style-h2 / --font_2. Section titles compute to 81.6px at 1440.

$extensions.source: Measured. --wst-font-style-h2. Computed on h2.font_2 'By the numbers'.

stat.$description: Statistic figures (22 Billion, 1.5 Billion, 1M) at 1440. No separate declared token; h2.font_2 scaled down.

$extensions.source: Measured. computed style on h2 '22 Billion', 1440.
Measured. --wst-font-style-h5 on :root.

body.$description: Declared --font_7 / --wst-font-style-body-large. Advertiser body copy computes to 22.2px / 26.64px at 1440.

$extensions.source: Measured. --font_7. Computed on p.font_7 'The network connecting…'.

caption.$description: Declared --font_9. Artist names and dates compute to 15.1px / 16.61px at 1440.

$extensions.source: Measured. --font_9. Computed on p.font_9 'Lady Gaga'.

nav.$description: Desktop nav labels. Horizontal padding 10px. Phone menu items are 22px.

$extensions.source: Measured. computed style on header p.wGxoBM 'About', 1440. Phone menu a 'About' is 22px white.

button.$description: Pill button label. The anchor itself reports 10px Arial; the visible label is the inner span.

$extensions.source: Measured. computed style on span.wixui-button__label inside a.wixui-button 'About Us'.
Measured. --cookie-banner-font-size and Accept button computed font-size.
Measured. cookie buttons and header radius 0px.

pill.$description: Marketing pill buttons (About Us, Learn More). Height is 46px, so this is a full pill.

$extensions.source: Measured. a.wixui-button border-radius 24px, height 46px, 1440.

gutter.$description: Hero and section content inset from the viewport edge at 1440. At 390 the hero inset is 21px.

$extensions.source: Measured. h1 getBoundingClientRect().x at 1440. Phone hero x is 21.

nav-pad.$description: Horizontal padding on each desktop nav label.

$extensions.source: Measured. header p.wGxoBM padding 0px 10px.

button-pad-x.$description: Cookie Decline and Accept horizontal padding. Pill buttons size to the label; About Us is 121px wide by 46px tall.

$extensions.source: Measured. cookie button padding 0px 16px. Pill width and height from getBoundingClientRect.

header.$description: Desktop header height. Phone header is 49px.

$extensions.source: Measured. header getBoundingClientRect height 77 at 1440, 49 at 390.
